name: Draxie
body:
APPEARANCE

This smiling reptilian sprite has vibrant scales and membranous wings, with large, round, and brightly colored eyes contrasting with vivid frills. Its riotous coloration is matched only by its ebullient cheerfulness and winsome grin.

Draxie
CR 3

XP 800
CG Tiny fey
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)
hp 27 (5d6+10)
Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +5
DR 5/cold iron

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft. (average)
Melee bite +7 (1d4–1)
Ranged euphoric spark +7 (2d4+3 electricity)
Space 2–1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (15-ft. cone, variable effect, DC 14 Will negates, usable every 1d4 rounds)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +8)

At will—dancing lights, ghost sound (DC 13), prestidigitation
3/day—disguise self
1/day—faerie fire, invisibility

TACTICS

Before Combat The draxie uses dancing lights and ghost sound to distract foes.

During Combat The draxie makes liberal use of her breath weapon. Otherwise, she flies out of the way of foes and make euphoric spark attacks.

Morale If reduced to fewer than 5 hit points, the draxie flees combat.

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 17, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 17
Base Atk +2; CMB +3; CMD 12
Feats Acrobatic, Weapon Finesse, Wingover
Skills Bluff +11, Diplomacy +11, Fly +17, Knowledge (nature) +9, Perception +9, Stealth +19
Languages Common, Draconic, Sylvan; telepathy (touch)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Su)

The draxie breathes pixie dust, creating a random effect each time she uses her breath weapon. Roll 1d4 to determine the effect.

The target is affected by the charm person spell for 5 minutes.
The target loses its last 5 minutes of memory.
The target is affected by the sleep spell for 5 minutes.
The target takes 1d4 Wisdom damage and is staggered for 1 round.
Euphoric Spark (Su)

The draxie adds her Charisma modifier to her euphoric spark’s damage. The spark has a maximum range of 20 feet.

ABOUT

The mischievous dragon sprites known as draxies have dueled their pixie cousins for the title of ultimate prankster for centuries. Possessed of draconic features and brilliant colorations, draxies descend from a mighty faerie dragon, reincarnated into multiple draxies after her death in the mercurial fashion of the fey realm. Draxies exercise patience and planning to create the perfect pranks, spending months, or even years, on their efforts. One exception to the flighty nature of draxies is the elucrea, a lifelong bond formed between a draxie and a creature or creatures the draxie is particularly fond of, typically those with a good sense of humor.
